newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks steady to lower in OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks steady to lower in OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the counter securities market in Varazdin for Monday, October 14.
* One of eight traded issues rose, two fell and five were unchanged.
* 10 stock VIN index up 206 points to 9,626 points.
* Volume lower at 1,553 units, turnover 141,034 German marks.
* The only gainer was investment fund Breza, adding 16 percent to 58 marks on volume of 150 shares.
* Biggest loser, textile firm Varteks, fell 18.37 percent to 40 marks, with 100 shares sold.
* Most actively traded was hotelier Riviera, fell 0.71 percent to 69.5 marks on volume of 400 shares.
